title: New York bands, Meyer Davis one-nighters, and Detroit with Goldkette and Finzel
summary: Talk of Red Nichols, the Memphis Five, short jobs, and Detroit: Henry Thies, Finzel's ballrooms, the Goldkette band with the Dorseys and Venuti, how he got the name Tex, and many sidemen.
